properties.displayName: CCC.Core.CN04 - Virtual machines must have boot diagnostics enabled
properties.description: Audits virtual machines that do not have boot diagnostics enabled, which provides platform/serial telemetry for access and troubleshooting. Maps to FINOS CCC Core CN04 (Log All Access and Changes) and enforces the AVM virtual-machine sample setting 'boot_diagnostics = true'. Note: full access/change auditing also requires diagnostic settings and guest-level logging via Azure Monitor Agent.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy.
